== Kobold Gem of Disguising ==
[[File:Kobold Gem of Disguising orb.png|right|alt=Kobold Gem of Disguising, focus orb]]
[[File:Kobold Gem of Disguising.png|right|alt=Kobold Gem of Disguising, description]]
A gem empowered with the ability to... turn you into a kobold?!

Use this gem in a crystal collection [[challenge]] to alter your appearance with a Kobold Costume: you will look like a [[Kobold Union Worker|kobold worker]] bearing barrels loaded with crystals. Monsters you run into will be fooled into considering you a good target.

Acquired by:
* Killing monsters in the challenge, {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}
* Purchase from the [[DDOstore/Gear_and_Equipment#Challenge Tools|DDO Store]], {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}

Usable in the following crystal collection challenges:
* {{Verified|'''[[Treasure of Crystal Cove]]'''}}
* {{Unverified|'''Extraplanar Mining:'''}}
** [[Extraplanar Palace: Buying Time| Buying Time]]
** [[Extraplanar Palace: Buying Time - EPIC| Buying Time - EPIC]]
** [[Extraplanar Palace: Labor Shortage| Labor Shortage]]
** [[Extraplanar Palace: Labor Shortage - EPIC| Labor Shortage - EPIC]]
** [[Extraplanar Palace: The Dragon's Hoard| The Dragon's Hoard]]
** [[Extraplanar Palace: The Dragon's Hoard - EPIC| The Dragon's Hoard - EPIC]]
